purpose: The context of use of the Hughes 2019 lenalidomide model on the platform, as enforceable rules. Written from results already on record; no new computation. Policy chosen by the platform owner on 30 October 2026: where the model was fitted on such patients but a locked outside check found it inconsistent, compute, flag and show the observed data; beyond the model's own data, refuse.

evidence_tiers.externally_checked: Inside a locked outside check whose primary result was consistent in every scenario.
evidence_tiers.inside_model_data: Inside the data the model was built on, not checked against outside data on this platform.
evidence_tiers.external_check_disagrees: Inside the model's data, but a locked outside check found the model inconsistent here: computed, flagged and shown with the observed data.

supported.label: Typical-value concentration curve and exposure
supported.evidence: The model's own output for the record's estimated covariates; its evidence is the weakest tier among the rules that admitted the record.

not_supported.label: This patient's concentrations
not_supported.reason: Typical values only; between-patient variability is not shown and no measured concentrations are used.

request_rules.basis: Hughes 2019 pooled MM (20), CLL (49), AML (53) and ALL (3) patients (coverage_contract disease_counts). The outside study's disease context is not established (observed design.population_disease_context).

outside_reason.default: Disease not represented in the model's data.
outside_reason.UNKNOWN: Disease not declared; cannot determine whether the record is inside the model's data.

tier_by_band.band_note: Normal (> 80 mL/min) and mild (50-80) groups: exposure consistent with study CC-5013-PK-001 in all four scenarios (external_check_report).
Moderate group (30-50 mL/min): the model under-predicted exposure about 2.1-fold (ratio to normal 2.2-fold) in all four scenarios (external_check_report). Read the curve as substantially too low.

state_rules.basis: The model's creatinine clearance covariate (Cockcroft-Gault, with the weight basis assumption recorded in the estimate); model data 36-211 mL/min (coverage_contract covariate_ranges).

outside_reason.below: Below the model's data (36 mL/min). The outside study observed much higher exposure in moderate and severe renal impairment (shown below); the model under-predicted both groups about 2-2.5-fold.

outside_reason.default: Fat-free mass outside the model's data.
Serum creatinine outside the model's data.

enforced_elsewhere: Dose amounts (2.5-75 mg listed in the source) and schedules are checked by the existing calculation (treatment request validation and coverage review).
unknown_policy: A rule whose input is unknown cannot be evaluated; the record is then 'cannot_determine' and no output is computed. Unknown stays unknown.
never_claimed: A prediction for a real patient, a dose recommendation or a judgement of treatment suitability.
Validation of the model; validation flags stay false.
